places.cuisine: Chicken-shoyu tsukemen ¥1,330 (medium) · gentle, chicken-rich soy dipping sauce with tenkasu and black shichimi · smooth, glossy noodles · chicken paitan with medium-thick curly noodles, and a limited chicken paitan curry ball · summer chilled niboshi soba ¥1,250 with a furikake rice to finish as cold chazuke · 5 counter seats, four 2-person tables
places.notes: [Ramen · a two-person tsukemen shop at the south end of Otaroad] A 13-seat noodle shop at the southern tip of Nipponbashi's Otaroad, open since 2013 and run by two: a chef in the kitchen and one person serving, both notably polite. The draw is chicken-shoyu tsukemen (¥1,330 for medium): smooth, glossy noodles and a gentle soy dipping sauce full of chicken, with tenkasu and black shichimi, mild enough to drink on its own. There's also chicken paitan on medium-thick curly noodles; this autumn it carried a curry ball you break into the broth. In summer the chilled niboshi soba (¥1,250) comes with a rice to drown in the cold broth. One bowl took about 15 minutes. Lunch only; closed Tuesdays.

anecdotes.text: "The soy sauce-based dipping sauce was not too strong and incredibly delicious!… I personally prefer a gentler flavor that I could drink on its own." — October 2026, chicken-shoyu tsukemen.
"I was advised to pour the broth over the rice, giving it a chilled chazuke-like experience. The furikake sprinkled on the rice added a nice accent." — August 2026, chilled niboshi soba.

places.cuisine: Clam-broth chuka soba · kaidashi shio ramen · asari shoyu ramen · shio set with clam tsukudani rice · seasoned egg and menma · thin-sliced chashu · smooth, chewy noodles, extra noodles · meat soba · cold pasta (2023) · sansho and Yamatsu Tsujita shichimi on the counter · 8 counter seats
places.notes: [Ramen · clam-broth chuka soba for lunch near Nagahoribashi] An eight-seat lunch counter near Nagahoribashi, open since 2021, built on a clear shellfish broth. The kaidashi shio ramen tastes most clearly of clam, light yet deep. The asari shoyu is lighter still, too subtle for some, and the shichimi from Sakai's Yamatsu Tsujita lifts it. Smooth, chewy noodles are the constant praise; one diner ordered extra noodles. Thin chashu, seasoned egg and menma complete the bowl, and the shio set adds rice with clam tsukudani; sansho on the counter suits it. There's also a meat soba, and it once served cold pasta. A calm room with many women dining. Lunch only, Monday to Saturday. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Clam-broth chuka soba, lunch only (Tabelog, staff-maintained).

anecdotes.text: "The broth was a beautifully clear clam soup, and the noodles were smooth and delicious!… The clam tsukudani (sweet simmered clams) was also great with both the rice and ramen." — September 2026, shio set.
"You can really taste the clam broth in this shio ramen. The richness is sufficient even without changing the flavor of the soup." — June 2026.

places.cuisine: Beef-bone ramen · recommended shio beef-bone ramen · white-broth ramen · tender beef tendon, stew-like chashu · thin straight noodles · fried garlic chips, pickled ginger and sesame · free extra noodles, or rice at lunch · summer chilled noodles with pork shabu-shabu, aosa and lemon · 9 counter seats
places.notes: [Ramen · a one-person beef-bone counter near Nagahoribashi] A nine-seat counter open since 2016, run single-handed by the owner, serving beef-bone ramen until midnight. The broth is rich yet clean, with no off-flavor, and one diner called it richer than tonkotsu. The recommended shio bowl and the white broth come over thin straight noodles that one diner likened to Hong Kong wonton noodles, topped with tender beef tendon or stew-soft chashu, fragrant fried garlic chips, sesame and pickled ginger. Extra noodles are free, or rice at lunch. Summer brought a chilled bowl with pork shabu-shabu, aosa and lemon. Service is warmer than the name suggests: one diner was seen off at the door. Buy a ticket at the machine; PayPay accepted.

chef_bio.background: Beef-bone ramen counter run by the owner alone (May 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "The broth was free of any unpleasant odors or bitterness, and it was very delicious! It had a nice thickness and was easy to drink!" — October 2026.
"The fragrant fried garlic chips are the standout feature of this restaurant, adding an incredible aroma that makes you want to eat more." — May 2026, shio beef-bone ramen.
